question: What is the meaning of environmental cost indicators transport phase a4 in relation to sustainability, environmental cost indicators?
data_point: environmental cost indicators transport phase a4
description: The environmental cost indicators transport phase A4 in relation to sustainability refer to the environmental impacts associated with the transportation of building materials during the construction process. This phase is part of the building life cycle and is crucial for understanding the environmental footprint of a building. The indicators help in assessing the energy consumption, emissions, and other environmental impacts caused by the transportation of materials, which can inform sustainable design and construction decisions.
